name: dungeon-system
description: Project diagnosis, safe adoption, SKLT navigation, task traces, build evidence, and experimental Git/Scion version-scope inspection.

interface.displayName: Dungeon System — Project Structure, Navigation & Evidence
interface.shortDescription: Connect repositories, navigate SKLT, and trace implementation evidence.
interface.longDescription: Probe existing repositories, browse SKLT_ONLY projects before adoption, and apply reviewed plans to MANAGED projects. Select relevant modules, objects and declared source/GLIF links; trace tasks, tests and CAS evidence and keep Prototype/Product coverage separate. Git, Toolkit execution, compilers and tests retain their authority; SKLT alone does not establish runtime correctness.
defaultPrompt: Покажи структуру Dungeon System и состояние проекта.
Найди объект по object_id и открой его SKLT.
Проверь изменения структуры и обнови проекции.
